name: Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place
positioning: The Ritz-Carlton Jakarta, Pacific Place (the official name uses 'The'), a hotel in the Sudirman Central Business District with a Club Lounge open to all guests, a spa on the 8th floor garden and PA.SO.LA Restaurant
best_for: Business travelers who want direct access to the Indonesia Stock Exchange
Guests who want Club Lounge access in any room category and a garden spa

facts.text: The hotel is in the Sudirman Central Business District, in the heart of downtown Jakarta.
The hotel has direct access to the Indonesia Stock Exchange.
Pacific Place Mall is just steps from the hotel.
Guest rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and sunken marble baths.
A walking wardrobe is available in all guest rooms and suites.
Club guests receive complimentary pressing of two items per night and Diptyque toiletries.
PA.SO.LA Restaurant is on level 6 of the hotel.
The Cigar Lounge on level 6 has a curated collection of premium cigars from around the world.
From April 2026 to March 2027, the restaurants serve Loka Rasa, ten Indonesian dishes reinterpreted by five chefs.
After a treatment, the spa serves a Jamu Ritual of herbal drinks that celebrate Indonesia's wellness heritage.
Self parking is complimentary for guests.
The hotel has an airport shuttle to Jakarta Soekarno-Hatta International Airport.

highlights.text: Guests staying in any room category have access to the Club Lounge.
Guest rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and sunken marble baths.
The spa is set in the lush garden on the hotel's 8th floor and uses organic, customized products.
PA.SO.LA Restaurant builds its menu around local farmers and food artisans.
The Health Club next to the spa has a cascading swimming pool, an outdoor walking track and two private gazebos.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the hotel is in a busy commercial district with heavy traffic.
You must be 17 years of age or older to use the spa relaxation areas, locker areas and pool.
Online reservations are not available for the spa.
